name: AD4 P6.1 - Clock (dispatch the tick hourly, intraday every 4 h)

parameters.content:
## AD4 P6.1 - Clock

GitHub's own cron dropped 6 of the tick's first 7 hourly runs on 24 Sep, and started none of intraday's 00:15, 08:15 and 16:15 runs. n8n's schedules fired on the minute all week, so the clock lives here and GitHub only runs what it is asked to.

Every hour at :36 UTC this dispatches:
- tick.yml (the checkpoint writer), every hour
- pipeline_intraday.yml, at 00, 04, 08, 12, 16 and 20 UTC

:36, not :35: P0.4 starts at :34 and P0.5 at 22:38, and the stagger test needs each one's measured runtime plus a minute of room.

The CLOCK table in "Due this hour" is read by tests/test_github_actions.py and counted against the Actions minute budget (Rule 7). Change the cadence there and nowhere else.

Set up: Config -> github_owner, github_repo, supabase_url. Dispatch uses the credential "AD4 Github Actions", the one Relearn uses. Each run is logged to ingest_log as job "P6.1_clock"; pause the clock by setting that job to off on the Workflows page (settings.workflow_schedules, sql/ad4_90_clock.sql).
